         AMPELOPSIS QUINQUEFOLIA

       Virginia Creeper

      (AMPELOPSIS)


Renal dropsies, hydrocele, and chronic hoarseness in scrofulous patients
      have been benefited by this drug. Choleric symptoms. Generally worse about 6 pm. Dilated
      pupils. Left costal region sore and sensitive. Elbow joints pain, back sore. Soreness of all
      limbs. Vomiting, purging with tenesmus. Rumbling in abdomen.



Dose.--  Second to third potency.
